thread:
mira_cs: Kicking off ACME QBR prep thread — date Tue 10/17 9am PT. Need slide owners, renewal ask, and known risks.
jen_sales: Can we get renewal ARR and current commit on the first slide? I can add competitive notes.
taylor_csm: I'll take onboarding + activation metrics. Need latest activation funnel CSV.
raj_product: I'll prepare cost-savings scenarios (batching + quantization). Will need token histogram (30d) and sample prompts.
alex_eng: I'll add latency SLOs and a one-slide remediation plan for ingestion lag.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: slides repo check: branch main is 1 commit behind
mira_cs: Uploading current deck version `qbr_assets/ACME_QBR_draft_v1.pptx`. Also adding customer feedback bullets: billing confusion, long doc ingestion, prompt truncation.
taylor_csm: Onboarding note — 3 customers still in 'trial' >14 days. Adding micro-survey results to slide notes.
jen_sales: Renewal risk: customer flagged token costs and unclear line items. Suggest offering 3-month pilot pricing or cost cap option.
raj_product: I'll model two asks: (A) one-time credit + pilot, (B) revised pricing tier. Will include projected token delta and cost impact.
alex_eng: Quick question: do you want the runbook excerpt for 'ingestion retries' or the SLO trend graph? Execs prefer the graph.
taylor_csm: Graph + one-liner runbook. Keep it high level.
mira_cs: Action items (owner + accept criteria): 1) ARR slide — @jen_sales (Fri noon, slide with committed ARR and churn risk callout). 2) Activation funnel — @taylor_csm (Fri 5pm, CSV + slide). 3) Cost scenarios — @raj_product (Mon 10am, chart + assumptions). 4) Latency/SLO slide — @alex_eng (Mon noon, graph + 1-line remediation). 5) Exec ask + script — @mira_cs (Mon 2pm, 2-slide ask with A/B options). 6) Slide polish — all (Mon 4pm PT run-through).
raj_product: Dropping token histogram + sample prompt set to `qbr_assets/tokens_30d.csv` now.
taylor_csm: Added survey bullets to slide 5.
jen_sales: I'll draft renewal email template for execs to send post-QBR.
alex_eng: Pushed SLO screenshot and brief note about transient ingestion backlog.
mira_cs: Also capturing mitigation options: temporary free tier for ingestion, prioritized ingest pipeline patch, billing line-item cleanup. Call these out under 'Risks & Asks'.
taylor_csm: Can we schedule a 20m dry-run Tue 8:30am PT? prefer to rehearse talking points.
jen_sales: 8:30am works for me.
raj_product: Works for me.
deploy-bot: calendar-bot: meeting created "ACME QBR dry-run" Tue 8:30-9:00am PT (invites sent).
mira_cs: Thanks team. Please add acceptance criteria inside slide notes (e.g., 'scenario B shows >=25% cost reduction vs baseline').
